no-restricted-syntax.message: ❌ Direct pixel font sizes are not allowed. Use semantic typography tokens: text-display-lg, text-heading-lg, text-heading-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-meta
❌ Tailwind size utilities are not allowed. Use semantic typography tokens: text-display-lg, text-heading-lg, text-heading-md, text-body-lg, text-body-md, text-body-sm, text-meta
❌ Direct hex background colors are not allowed. Use tokens: bg-background, bg-surface-card, bg-surface-slate, bg-surface-alt, bg-primary-accent
❌ Direct hex text colors are not allowed. Use semantic tokens: text-foreground, text-secondary, text-tertiary
❌ Direct hex border colors are not allowed. Use tokens: border, border-subtle
❌ Arbitrary duration values are not allowed. Use motion tokens: duration-motion-ultrafast, duration-motion-fast, duration-motion-medium
⚠️ Inline styles should be avoided. Use className with design system tokens instead.

🚫 ORANGE TEXT VIOLATION: 'text-primary' resolves to orange (#F7931E). Use semantic tokens instead: text-foreground, text-secondary, text-tertiary. Only use text-primary-accent for intentional accent elements.
